lines.text: When Cephas came to Antioch, Paul opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned.
Before men came from James, Cephas ate with the Gentiles, but he drew back, and even Barnabas was led astray.
Paul said to Cephas in front of them all that he compelled the Gentiles to live like Jews.
Paul says a man is justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ.

wrong_details.true: is not justified by works of the law, but

lines.text: Paul says he has been crucified with Christ, and Moses lives in him.
